enemy.name: Thalebeast
enemy.flavour_text: A mossback beast covered in thale, a plant native to Arsalan that is highly sensitive to environmental changes. This allows the Thalebeast to predict shifts in the weather.

abilities.text: Helps your side when on the field; unblockable.
During <Thunderstorm> and <Thunderburst>, always draws thunder strikes to the tiles it passes through while itself is immune to thunder strike damage.
During <Scorching Sun> and <Bright Sun>, attacks inflict a certain percentage of Burn. Nearby enemy units also gain a certain percentage of Elemental Fragility.
Gains Invisibility and increased attack range in <Sandstorm> and <Great Sandstorm>.
